summary: Provision partner collaboration gateway: gated Slack channels + ephemeral Confluence dossier + PII-scrubbing export
description:
Issue summary:
Product Partnerships requested a reusable automation (Partner Collaboration Gateway) that provisions a scoped, timebound collaboration environment for external partners: a Slack channel (private, invited guests), a Confluence dossier pre-populated with templates and an audit manifest, and a corresponding Jira project template for action items. The automation must enforce RBAC, run a PII redaction pass on exported content before long-term storage, and automatically archive + export assets at a configurable TTL.

Impact:
- Manual channel/space provisioning for partners is error-prone and inconsistent; setup time averages 3+ days.
- Security team wants per-channel audit manifests and automated PII redaction on exports to meet data-sharing agreements.
- Partnerships team wants a self-service button to create partner workspaces with built-in templates and timebound guest access.

Request details / requirements:
1) Self-service 'Create Partner Workspace' endpoint in the admin console that creates: Slack private channel (prefixed partner-<org>), Confluence space with the Partner Dossier template, and a Jira project with issue templates.
2) Approval guardrail: creation requires one Approver from Security or Legal; requests enter an approval queue.
3) RBAC snapshots: capture membership and permission sets at creation and on closure for audit.
4) TTL lifecycle: workspace expires after N days (configurable per request); on expiry run export pipeline: redact PII, generate an audit log bundle, upload to secure archive, then archive/delete workspace.
5) PII scrubber: integrate an existing redaction microservice or run a redaction lambda to remove/replace emails, phone numbers, SSNs, and API keys from channel history and Confluence pages in the export.
6) Slack policy: limit guest invites to enumerated domains; prevent file uploads from guests if requested by partner.
7) Observability: create an event log (created_by, approver, TTL, snapshot location) and surface in console under 'Partner Workspaces'.

Acceptance criteria:
- Admin console exposes a form and returns a request id.
- Approved requests result in Slack channel + Confluence space + Jira project being provisioned within 15 minutes.
- RBAC snapshot stored in secure audit S3 with link in Jira issue.
- Export pipeline produces a zipped export and redaction report; report confirms no PII pattern matches remaining.
- Demo run completed with Partner Beta group (3 partners) and Security signoff.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - new automation request; no reproduction steps

investigation_notes: Identified existing building blocks: Slack provisioning via SCIM + Slack admin API; Confluence space templates exist for Partner Dossier (confluence key: PART-DOSSIER); internal redaction microservice 'redact-svc' is experimental and only supports email/phone - needs extension for API keys/SSNs.

Slack export constraints: workspace export requires Enterprise export privileges; channel export for private channels must use Conversations.history with token of a workspace admin and obey rate limits (recommended: 1 req/sec with exponential backoff).
Confluence export: Use 'export space' API which returns HTML/XML; we should run redaction on HTML text nodes, then re-package as a sanitized archive.

RBAC snapshot plan: capture Slack channel membership via Conversations.members at creation, Confluence space permissions via space API, and Jira project roles via REST API; store JSON manifests in secure audit bucket with signed links in Jira issue metadata.

Approval flow options: (A) use existing Jira approval workflow with Security approver group; (B) use a small self-serve portal that posts an approval request to #security-approvals and waits for a +1. Recommend (A) for auditability.
Data retention & TTL: default 90 days TTL; allow partners to request longer TTLs (requires Legal signoff).
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 - Workplan established, dependencies mapped. Next steps: implement PoC for incremental Slack + Confluence export with redact-svc integration. Security to expand redact-svc capabilities and provide test patterns. Platform to build console form and a Jira-based approval webhook.

Temporary workaround for immediate partner onboarding: manual provisioning checklist created in Confluence + RBAC snapshot saved manually to secure audit bucket. Use manual redaction by Security on exports until automated scrubber is ready.
Owner: Omar Kim (Platform) responsible for end-to-end delivery; Security owner: Luis Fernandez; SRE: Tara Nguyen for export reliability and rate limiting.
